text:
maya: Quick sync — final pass on site pages for Hosted/Dedicated/Private before launch posts + webinar. Need hero lines + CTA routing. Who's available?
vincent: I can take hero for Hosted + benchmark angle for the blog post. Thinking: "Predictable LLM inference, anywhere you run it." Thoughts?
sarah: Two hero options per mode. Short A/B. For Hosted: A) "Start with hosted — pay-as-you-go inference" B) "Hosted API: fastest path to production." Which is closer to our tone?
leo: Lean toward B for conversions. Also need a compact subhead to fit mobile.
vincent: For the benchmark narrative — we should include comparative numbers. Tim, can you share p50/p95 latency and cost numbers we can cite?
tim: Yup. Quick sample: Hosted small-ctx p50 ~50ms, Dedicated optimized p50 ~25ms; p95 hosted ~220ms; we'll redact internal labels. I'll paste a short snippet for the blog.
tim: ```
model: redwood-v1
context: 1024
hosted_p50_ms: 50
dedicated_p50_ms: 25
hosted_p95_ms: 220
``` 
sarah: For CTAs — prefer: Hosted -> "Get started" (self-serve), Dedicated -> "Contact sales", Private -> "Talk to solutions". Webinar CTA should route to a separate flow capturing company size and primary use-case.
maya: For inbound routing mapping: if user selects 'Enterprise' -> tag 'AE' + create slack alert channel #ae-inbound; 'Startup/Prototype' -> marketing drip. Can engineering support the tag hook from form responses today?
leo: I'll update hero comps and mobile stacks, then upload to Figma. Expect screenshots in 90m.
vincent: I'll draft the blog outline + webinar blurb. Proposed webinar date: Wed May 10 — title: "Serving LLMs at scale: benchmarks & economics".
sarah: I'll prepare 3 copy variants per mode, plus a short prompt-based snippet to demonstrate latency/cost benefits on the Hosted page.
maya: Action items: vincent — blog + webinar draft; sarah — copy variants; tim — latency snippet + quick FAQ bullets; leo — hero comps; maya — coordinate launch posts, webinar calendar, and inbound tag wiring. Thanks :rocket:
